from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
a = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
h,w,_=a.shape
R,G,B = a[...,0],a[...,1],a[...,2]
# classes: dark bg, wood brown, white mug, gray metal, other
white = (R>200)&(G>200)&(B>200)
brown = (R>90)&(R>G+15)&(G>B+10)&(B<150)
gray = (abs(R-G)<18)&(abs(G-B)<18)&(R>70)&(R<=200)
dark = (R<40)&(G<40)&(B<40)
# downsample masks to 64x40
def ds(m):
    im=Image.fromarray((m*255).astype('uint8')).resize((64,40))
    return np.array(im)>127
Wm,Bm,Gm,Dm = ds(white),ds(brown),ds(gray),ds(dark)
for r in range(40):
    line=''
    for c in range(64):
        if Wm[r,c]: ch='M'
        elif Bm[r,c]: ch='.'
        elif Gm[r,c]: ch='A'
        elif Dm[r,c]: ch=' '
        else: ch='?'
        line+=ch
    print(line)
\""
